column3: Setup: Use the update_request_rejection testdrive - it supplies journal_3 ('Update Request Rejection - Reject Resubmit Unreject <run_seed>'), an in-DOAJ journal that already has this test's full 'reject, then resubmit' history pre-built: one Update Request already Rejected (titled '...rejected UR (try to unreject this one) <run_seed>') and a second, newer Update Request that is currently open against the same journal (titled '...resubmitted UR (currently open) <run_seed>', status Update Request). Pre-building both avoids two live submissions to the same journal in quick succession, which risks tripping DOAJ's real update-request submission cooldown - this test is about the 'cannot unreject while a newer one is open' guard, not the submissions themselves. OR provide those yourself.

Setup: Important: the testdrive page tears down its data as soon as you navigate away from it. Log in and run the test in a separate browser tab/window, leaving the testdrive tab open until you have finished.
Confirm the resubmitted Update Request for journal_3 is currently open via the admin area search

column4: The record contains the value "Update Request For: [journal_3 id]"

column3: Locate the older, already-Rejected Update Request for journal_3 (titled '...rejected UR (try to unreject this one)') via the admin area search

column4: You receive an error message saying that the Update Request cannot be unrejected
